content: {"summary":"Customers report frequent order mix‑ups, such as plain burgers served with onions and extra toppings, and missing items like whipped cream, leading to frustration and coupon offers as compensation. [#tk_2441985] They also complain about last‑minute cancellations of promotional deals, causing staff dissatisfaction and questioning the value of offers. [#tk_2420935] Long delivery times, sometimes exceeding an hour, and confusion over duplicate orders or missing notifications further aggravate users. [#tk_2388093]"}
